payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the pruning process applied to the training data of the KDG model, indicating its significance in improving model accuracy.

claims.text: The pruning step eliminates spurious training data entries, which is crucial for improving the accuracy of the KDG model.
Disabling the pruning step results in a significant drop in model accuracy from 43.3% to 36.3%, highlighting its importance.
Pruning out spurious logical forms before training is an important factor in the performance improvement of the KDG model.
